capabilities: Set attachment save paths with variables like ${notepath}, ${notename}, ${date} and ${md5}
Auto-rename attachments on paste, drop, and note rename in markdown and canvas files
Rearrange linked attachments to configured paths via command
Override attachment settings per file, folder, or extension
Exclude paths and extensions from processing
extras: The Rearrange linked attachments command is marked experimental and the README advises backing up files first; a Known Issues section documents rename-link caveats and a possible folder-name collision error.
intentEvidence: It can be set using the config of Obsidian in Files & Links and reset using this option.
problem: Obsidian's built-in attachment location setting is a fixed vault-wide folder, with no per-note paths, renaming on note rename, or per-folder overrides.
summary: Attachment path manager that saves pasted or dropped attachments to variable-based paths and auto-renames them when notes change.
